sources.citation: Mathews, R. H. 1901-02. The Thoorga language [Appendix: The Yookumbill language, pp. 63-67]. Queensland Geographical Journal 17: 49-73.
sources.note: Orthography p. 50: 'The accent is shown thus, Kul'la, and when two syllables are accented, both are marked in the same way.' The Yookumbill appendix (Upper Macintyre = Yugambal, the SISTER language, not Bigambal) gives accent-marked words (Bun'dar, gib'beer, uk'keether, woo'nar, mee'kai, gir'ri, goo'pee, bur'gan, koo'nee), overwhelmingly first-syllable, but states no rule. Data only, and for a different variety.
